text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Up and at 'em, once again! I'm off for the
first run!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm beginning to recognize more and more
just how composed
Tannhauser remains
during our training sessions.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff... I know that I need to build up some more stamina, but my body can't seem to keep up...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh well, nothing to it but to keep trying!
Can we do this again
tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She acknowledges her shortcomings easily
and tends not to let them
frustrate her.
She even takes it a step further
sometimes...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Considering your options... I think you
should focus on accelerating
faster as you
complete the last turn.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Nod, nod. I see, I see! Thanks muchly!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She proactively seeks advice from her
rivals without her pride being
hurt one bit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's often said that one requires
exceptional drive, persistence,
motivation,
and even luck to make it in the racing
world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Many might think that for someone as
seemingly normal as
Tannhauser, this
would be a treacherous path in life.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Aaand I'm back! All righty,
what's next for
today?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The Tracen Meet's tomorrow, so I wanna
make sure I'm in tippy-top
shape for my
rematch with Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If you can make it this far and still be
"normal"... Well, that has to be
special in
its own right.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's with that all of a sudden? Come
on... You're making me
blush!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Never letting her emotions hold her
back...
Pushing forward with a
smile on her face...
Her potential is practically limitless.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day at the Tracen Meet,
Matikanetannhauser is warming up
for her
1,600-meter rematch with the lauded
Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I think we can all remember the incredible
lead Mihono Bourbon won
with at her last
scrimmage. The excitement is palpable!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, looks like Matikanetannhauser's
running today too. She couldn't
quite
make it last time, but I wonder how she'll
do today.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Mun. Couldn't quite make it last time,
but this is this time! I'll be
taking first. Ei,
ei, mun!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
All of our runners have entered the
gates...
The 1,600-meter turf race
starts now!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon is in second place.
Matikanetannhauser is in fifth
place and
has already passed the 600-meter mark!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The runners are entering the fourth
corner. Mihono Bourbon runs in
second on the
outside. Is anyone prepared for a final
push?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(Okay, here's where I speed up to catch
her!)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Haaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon is in the lead. Mihono
Bourbon is in the lead with
200 meters to
go!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(Wh-what the heck is up with her crazy
acceleration?! No... Even so...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Really looking forward to what you've got
for us!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Really looking forward to what you've got
for us!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(It doesn't matter! I'm only here to take
home first!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Haaa!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The leader is still Mihono Bourbon! 100
meters remain!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Haaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's hot on her tail! Can they
overtake her? No, Mihono
Bourbon
prevails as she crosses the finish!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
No doubt about it—Mihono Bourbon is
here to stay!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
And did you see that performance by
Matikanetannhauser? She might have
finished fourth,
but she kept up right until
the end! Might have to keep an eye on her!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff... Ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whew, thanks so much! I only came in
fourth, but you still want to
treat me?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of... Too bad about that last
race. Looks like the big
leagues evade me
still.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks a lot. Ehe, you know, I still
feel like I got something out
of that race
to help me grow even more!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I can't really explain it,
but it's gotten me
pretty fired up to keep on
going, too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: And when I think about how you're looking forward to what I've got in store, I get even more pumped!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I guess it's pretty normal to turn
words of
encouragement into power
to succeed, but
I can't help but be surprised.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm starting to think that meeting you was
one of the luckiest things to
ever happen
to me, heehee.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Let's get right back to the grind
tomorrow.
But for now... halfsies!
